This pilot implements Bill's selected structure: separate original and remastered card lists, a changes comparison, and both versions together in the card view. The three cases are unchanged intentional blank text, a lore correction, and a revised weapon-deployment mode.

The original record follows the surviving playtest scan. The remastered record follows the approved revision. Intermediate reconstructions remain separately credited sources. Candidate images are labelled for review.

! Game text
| <nowiki>During your turn, target a site where your total power is more than double opponent's total power. Unless opponent has a Dark Jedi or character weapon there, place each opponent character, vehicle and starship there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. OR If a battle or duel was just initiated at a site, deploy a matching character weapon from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.</nowiki> || <nowiki>During your turn, target a site where your total power is more than double opponent's total power. Unless opponent has a Dark Jedi or character weapon there, place each opponent character, vehicle, and starship there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. OR If a battle or duel was just initiated at a site, search your hand or Reserve Deck for one unique weapon matching one of your participating characters. Immediately deploy that weapon (for free) on that character and reshuffle (if from Reserve Deck).</nowiki>
|}
Restore the original Armed And Dangerous weapon mode: own participating character, unique matching weapon, free deployment from hand or Reserve Deck. Ambush mode retained.

The weapon mode follows [[Armed And Dangerous]]; the first mode follows [[Ambush]]. Bill approved the text and full-card image on 29 October 2026. The [[:File:RG-GEMP-Armed-And-Dangerous-Ambush.png|published remaster]] contains the approved revision.
